flows:
Navigate to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/ then Assert the page heading says 'Welcome to the-internet'.
Click the 'Checkboxes' link.
Check the first checkbox.
Assert the first checkbox is checked.
Go back to the home page.

Click the 'Dropdown' link.
Select 'Option 2' from the dropdown.
Assert the dropdown shows 'Option 2'.
Go back to the home page.

Click the 'Add/Remove Elements' link.
Click the 'Add Element' button twice.
Assert there are 2 'Delete' buttons.
Click one 'Delete' button.
Assert there is 1 'Delete' button.
Get the number of 'Delete' buttons and save as {{delete_count}}.
